run_simulation: run the TORAX plasma simulation with a ToraxConfig and return output xarray and state history
create_ToraxConfig_from_dict: create a ToraxConfig from a dictionary using model_config.ToraxConfig.from_dict
create_FileRestart_config: create a file restart configuration using file_restart_pydantic.FileRestart.from_dict
load_state_file: load a reference TORAX simulation state from a netCDF file using output.load_state_file
update_ToraxConfig_fields: update specific fields in a ToraxConfig using update_fields with a nested dict path
convert_simulation_output_to_xr: convert simulation state history output to an xarray dataset using simulation_output_to_xr
test_simulation_restart: test TORAX simulation restart from a halfway reference point with stitch enabled
test_vloop_bc_equivalence: test equivalence of Ip boundary condition and VLoop boundary condition in TORAX
test_prescribed_psidot: test prescribed psidot usage when current evolution is disabled in TORAX
test_nan_detection: test that TORAX simulation detects NaN errors and stops before t_final
